title: What is Right to Repair? An introduction for curious people.
summary: Louis Rossmann gives a basic, non-technical introduction to right to repair legislation for people new to the issue.
why: Recommended as the accessible explanation to share with non-techies, family and politicians.

quote.text: I'd highly reccomended his video "What is right to repair? An introduction for curious people." as it clears up many misconceptions about right to repair
